title: feat(shipping): free shipping from 40 EUR
body: Marketing is lowering the free shipping threshold for the autumn campaign. Orders of 40 EUR or more now ship for free instead of 50 EUR or more.
author: acme-dev

files.patch:
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def shipping_fee(subtotal):
-    if subtotal >= 50:
+    if subtotal >= 40:
         return 0
     return 4.99
